source.inspectionScope: Complete31-line pref patch read; removes Nightly-only default branch. Historical consumer still excludes initial/no-account flow, fixed helper later always opens Hub and old pref absent in scoped mail grep. Explicit soft-freeze exception author rationale, not policy reversal. Existing rollout/routing lessons read; no startup/UI run.

commit bf0a0c5a06883f35956b5b74d0f9ba7fa758e20c
Author:     Alessandro Castellani <alessandro@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri May 23 22:01:26 2025 +0000
Commit:     Alessandro Castellani <alessandro@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Fri May 23 22:01:26 2025 +0000

    Bug 1968292 - Enable Account Hub email flow by default for second account setups. r=coreycb,vineet
    
    This goes against the not changing prefs during the pre-ESR soft freeze
    but this flow only kicks in from the second setup, not affecting the startup flow
    and also this option is controllable via the UI in the settings
    so if something goes wrong users can disable it easily
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D251024

diff --git a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
index fd4d4b12191..d7ec003c041 100644
--- a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
+++ b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
@@ -1483,11 +1483,7 @@ pref("mail.dark-reader.enabled", true);
 pref("mail.dark-reader.show-toggle", true);
 
 // Enable the new account setup (starting from the second account)
-#ifdef NIGHTLY_BUILD
 pref("mail.accounthub.enabled", true);
-#else
-pref("mail.accounthub.enabled", false);
-#endif
 
 // Enable address book setup via account hub
 pref("mail.accounthub.addressbook.enabled", false);
title: Bug 1968292 - Enable Account Hub email flow by default for second account setups. r=coreycb,vineet
